title: Practice Exam 1
description: 10 free-response coding challenges across Aviation, IoT, Fintech, Clean Energy, Healthcare, Logistics, Cybersecurity, Sports, Music, and Marine Engineering themes.

questions.title: Flight Ticket
questions.prompt:
Create a class named `FlightTicket` in `FlightTicket.java`:

* **Private fields:** `String passengerName`, `String flightNumber`, `int seatRow`, `double baseFare`.
* **Constructor 1:** `FlightTicket(String passengerName, String flightNumber, int seatRow, double baseFare)`
* **Constructor 2:** `FlightTicket(String passengerName, String flightNumber)` which sets `seatRow` to `30` and `baseFare` to `199.99`.
* **Getters and Setters:** For all four fields.
  * In `setSeatRow(int seatRow)`: A commercial aircraft only has rows 1 to 40 inclusive. If `seatRow < 1`, set `seatRow = 1`. If `seatRow > 40`, set `seatRow = 40`.
  * In `setBaseFare(double baseFare)`: Fare cannot be negative. If `baseFare < 0.0`, set `baseFare = 0.0`.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: 2-arg constructor default fields; upper row clamp (55 -> 40); negative fare clamp (-50.0 -> 0.0).

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Lower Row Clamp)
tests.description: setSeatRow(0) and setSeatRow(-5) clamp to 1.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Row Boundaries)
tests.description: Setting row to exactly 1 and 40 keeps 1 and 40.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (4-Arg Constructor)
tests.description: new FlightTicket("Neil Armstrong", "UA202", 12, 349.50) preserves all fields.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Zero Fare)
tests.description: setBaseFare(0.0) sets baseFare to 0.0.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (String Setters)
tests.description: setPassengerName and setFlightNumber update fields correctly.

graderCases.name: Sample run (2-arg defaults + clamps)
Lower row clamp
Row boundaries 1 and 40
4-arg constructor preserves fields
Zero fare allowed
graderCases.body:
FlightTicket t = new FlightTicket("A","B");
t.setBaseFare(0.0); eqD(t.getBaseFare(),0.0);

graderCases.name: String setters

questions.title: Smart Thermostat
questions.prompt:
Create a class named `Thermostat` in `Thermostat.java`:

* **Private fields:** `String deviceId`, `String roomName`, `double currentTemp`.
* **Constructor:** `Thermostat(String deviceId, String roomName, double currentTemp)`.
* **`toString()`:** Return:
  ```
  Device: <deviceId>
  Room: <roomName>
  Temp: <currentTemp formatted to 1 decimal place> F
  ```
  *(Separated by `\n` with no trailing newline)*
* **`equals(Object o)`:** Two thermostats are equal if their `deviceId` matches **ignoring case**, regardless of room name or temperature. Return `false` if `o` is `null` or not an instance of `Thermostat`.

Device: NEST-001
Room: Living Room
Temp: 72.5 F
Matches: true

questions.title: Bank Transaction Validator
questions.prompt:
Create a checked exception named `InsufficientFundsException` in `InsufficientFundsException.java` that extends `Exception` with a constructor taking `String message`.

In `AccountValidator.java`, implement:
`public static double processWithdrawal(double balance, double amount) throws InsufficientFundsException`
* If `amount <= 0.0`, throw `IllegalArgumentException` with message: `"Withdrawal amount must be positive"`.
* If `amount > balance`, throw `InsufficientFundsException` with message: `"Overdraft prevented: balance is <balance>, withdrawal requested is <amount>"`. (Use raw double in message).
* Otherwise, return `balance - amount`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Remaining: 60.0
Overdraft prevented: balance is 60.0, withdrawal requested is 75.0

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Valid withdrawal followed by InsufficientFundsException.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Exact Balance Withdrawal)
tests.description: processWithdrawal(50.0, 50.0) returns 0.0.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Zero Withdrawal Amount)
tests.description: processWithdrawal(100.0, 0.0) throws IllegalArgumentException.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Negative Withdrawal Amount)
tests.description: processWithdrawal(100.0, -15.0) throws IllegalArgumentException.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Checked Exception Verification)
tests.description: Verifies InsufficientFundsException extends Exception (not RuntimeException).

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Penny Overdraft)
tests.description: processWithdrawal(50.00, 50.01) throws InsufficientFundsException.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Remaining: 60.0
Overdraft prevented: balance is 60.0, withdrawal requested is 75.0

graderCases.body:

questions.title: Renewable Power Source
questions.prompt:
Create an interface named `RenewableSource` in `RenewableSource.java`:
* Abstract method: `double getDailyKWh();`
* Default method: `default double getAnnualKWh()`: returns `getDailyKWh() * 365.0`.
* Default method: `default boolean meetsTarget(double yearlyTarget)`: returns `true` if `getAnnualKWh() >= yearlyTarget`, else `false`.

Create a class named `SolarPanel` in `SolarPanel.java` that implements `RenewableSource`:
* **Private fields:** `double peakWattage`, `double dailySunHours`.
* **Constructor:** `SolarPanel(double peakWattage, double dailySunHours)`.
* Implement `getDailyKWh()`: formula is `(peakWattage * dailySunHours) / 1000.0`. If either field is negative, return `0.0`.

Annual: 730.00 kWh
Meets 700 kWh: true

questions.title: Hospital Personnel
questions.prompt:
Create a class `Employee` in `Employee.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String name`, `double hourlyRate`.
* **Constructor:** `Employee(String name, double hourlyRate)`.
* **Getters:** For both fields.
* Method `calculateWeeklyPay(double hoursWorked)`: returns `hourlyRate * hoursWorked`.

Create subclass `Nurse` in `Nurse.java` extending `Employee`:
* **Private field:** `boolean nightShift`.
* **Constructor:** `Nurse(String name, double hourlyRate, boolean nightShift)` calling `super`.
* Override `calculateWeeklyPay(double hoursWorked)`:
  * Overtime rule: Any hours over 40 are paid at `1.5 * hourlyRate`.
  * If `nightShift` is `true`, add a flat night differential bonus of `$150.00` to total pay.

questions.title: Warehouse Payload Manager
questions.prompt:
Given a base class `Container` with method `double getWeight()` and subclass `HeavyContainer` (which has additional tare reinforcement weight included in `getWeight()`), implement `PayloadManager.java`:
* `public static double totalWeight(Container[] containers)`:
  * Sums `getWeight()` across all containers polymorphically.
  * If `containers` is `null` or empty, return `0.0`.
  * If an array element is `null`, skip it safely.
* `public static int countOverweight(Container[] containers, double maxWeight)`:
  * Returns how many non-null containers have `getWeight() > maxWeight` (strictly greater).
  * If `containers` is `null`, return `0`.

*(The autograder provides `Container` and `HeavyContainer`. `Container` has a constructor `Container(double weight)` and `HeavyContainer(double base, double tare)` whose `getWeight()` returns `base + tare`.)*

questions.title: Server Access Log Parser
questions.prompt:
In `LogAnalyzer.java`, write:
`public static int countErrors(String filename, int targetHttpCode) throws FileNotFoundException`
* The file contains lines formatted as: `Timestamp IP HTTPStatus DurationMS` (space-separated).
  Example: `2026-03-31T10:14:00 192.168.1.5 404 120`
* Skip any line starting with `#` (comments) or lines that are empty.
* Parse the 3rd token as an `int` HTTP status code.
* Return the count of lines where `HTTPStatus == targetHttpCode`.
* If the file does not exist, let `FileNotFoundException` propagate. Ensure the file is closed cleanly using try-with-resources.

questions.title: Athletic Qualifiers Exporter
questions.prompt:
In `TrackMeetExporter.java`, write:
`public static int exportQualifiers(String inputFile, String outputFile, double maxQualifyingSeconds)`
* `inputFile` is a semicolon-separated file formatted as: `AthleteName;Team;EventTime`
  Example: `Usain;Jamaica;9.81`
* Filter athletes who ran fast enough: `EventTime <= maxQualifyingSeconds`.
* Write qualifying athletes to `outputFile`, one per line, formatted as:

* If `inputFile` cannot be found, catch `IOException`, print `"Input file not found"`, and return `-1`.

questions.title: Musical Instrument Hierarchy
questions.prompt:
Create abstract class `Instrument` in `Instrument.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String name`, `int baseDecibels`.
* **Constructor:** `Instrument(String name, int baseDecibels)`.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract int playNote(int intensity);`

Create subclass `Brass` in `Brass.java`:
* **Constructor:** `Brass(String name, int baseDecibels)`.
* Implementation of `playNote(int intensity)`:
  * Decibels produced: `baseDecibels + (intensity * 4)`.
  * If `intensity > 10`, add a brass distortion penalty of `15` decibels.

Create subclass `Woodwind` in `Woodwind.java`:
* **Constructor:** `Woodwind(String name, int baseDecibels)`.
* Implementation of `playNote(int intensity)`:
  * Decibels produced: `baseDecibels + (intensity * 2)`.
  * Maximum sound level is capped at `95` decibels. If calculated decibels exceeds 95, return `95`.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Woodwind Under Cap)

questions.title: Submarine Depth Simulator
questions.prompt:
Simulate a submarine dive sequence in `SubmarineDive.java`. Submarine starts at `Depth: 0` meters with `Hull Integrity: 100`%.

Each round: print `Depth: <depth>m | Integrity: <integrity>%`, display menu:
`1) Dive 50m  2) Surface 30m  3) Emergency Blow  4) Finish Mission`
* `1`: Dive 50m. Add 50 to depth. If new depth > 200m, hull suffers pressure stress: deduct `15` integrity per turn spent below 200m.
* `2`: Surface 30m. Subtract 30 from depth. Depth cannot drop below `0m` (clamped at 0).
* `3`: Emergency Blow: immediately resets depth to `0m`, but costs `25` integrity from stress.
* `4`: Print `Mission finished safely at depth <depth>m.` and terminate.
* **Any other input:** Print `Invalid command. Submarine drifts.` and deduct `5m` depth (clamped at 0).
* **Failure Condition:** If `Integrity <= 0` at any time, immediately print `CRITICAL: Hull breach detected! Mission failed.` and terminate.

Read menu choices from standard input with a `Scanner`.
questions.sampleRun:
// Input: 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 4
// (dive five times to 250m, emergency blow, finish)

Depth: 0m | Integrity: 60%
